question: Should this protected Discord test refactor proceed once final-head proof confirms that all split suites preserve the original non-isolated lifecycle/reset semantics?
rationale: The branch is test-only and plausibly sound, but the remaining gate is owner confidence in redistributed regression coverage plus inspectable proof rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Request final-head proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or a linked artifact showing the complete split-suite run, then perform the normal Discord owner review.

options.title: Accept the stated validation
options.body: Proceed based on the PR-body validation summary if the responsible Discord reviewer independently accepts the coverage risk.

recommendation.title: Request final-head proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or a linked artifact showing the complete split-suite run, then perform the normal Discord owner review.
